name: Rosneft
note: General sponsor of HC CSKA Moscow; РОСНЕФТЬ wordmark across the lower band of the 2026-27 jerseys (front and back) and on the sleeves, plus the Rosneft derrick logo on the upper back (club photo galleries, 2026-09). State stake: 40.4% via Rosneftegaz, which is in 100% federal ownership (RIA Novosti 2024-12-27; rosneft.com shareholder page, register data as of 1 July 2021).
